notes.content:
Fixed a bug in the first room puzzle.
Fixed a bug when pushing boxes.

notes.title: Fixed first room puzzle, changed where some monsters appear.
notes.content:
Changed where some monsters appear.
Fixed the first room puzzle.

notes.title: Item box bug fix.
notes.content: Fixed a bug where moving ammo from an item box to your inventory could cause an error that prevented you from progressing in the game.

notes.title: Bug fixes and options menu.
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where players would not take damage when attacked by a machine.

Added the ability to change between full screen and windowed mode to the options.

notes.title: Changed drawer puzzle hint, fixed tentacle monster judgment bug.
notes.content:
Changed the hint for the drawer puzzle inside the purple door.
Fixed a judgment bug when a tentacle monster attacks the player.

And you can change to windowed mode by pressing F4.

notes.title: Bug fixes and item additions.
notes.content:
Bug where the hand position is off the drawer and unable to open it - Fixed

Bug with no sound when Tab is pressed - Fixed

Item - Added Regeneration Syringe.

Item - We've also temporarily added a shotgun that we were planning to add at launch - please note that if you've passed the place where you get the shotgun in an existing save, you won't get it if you go back to it.

notes.title: We've found a few bugs and are working on fixing them.
notes.content:
Bug where the hand position is off the drawer and unable to open it - This is resolved by exiting and re-entering the drawer, or by restarting the game.
Bug with no sound when Tab is pressed - This is resolved by cycling the game if the bug occurs.
We are currently working on fixing the bug.

notes.title: [Device 0101] Early Access released April 1 at 9pm PDT.
notes.content:
[Device 0101] Early Access released April 1 at 9pm PDT.

The game is still in development, so not all content will be available, but we hope you'll play and review it.

Thank you.
